ai_summary: This document summarizes the 33rd Annual General Meeting of Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited, outlining discussions on adopting FY2025-26 financials, declaring a dividend, and director reappointments. A material impact stems from the proposed reappointment of the Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Nitin Bhandari, for five years with an *increased remuneration*. The primary red flag is that the document explicitly states voting results for all resolutions, including the remuneration hike, are pending and will be announced later, leaving the outcomes of these key decisions undisclosed.
